question.problem:
A social media influencer had $100$ followers the day she created her account. Since then, the number $F(t)$ of followers after $t$ weeks can be modeled by the function

$$
F(t)=100\cdot {3}^{t}.
$$

How many weeks will it take for the followers to increase to $72\,900?$
question.worked_solution:
To find the time it takes for the number of followers to increase to $72\,900,$ we need to solve the equation $F(t)=72\,900$ for $t,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}F(t) & =72\,900 \\ 100\cdot {3}^{t} & =72\,900 \\ {3}^{t} & =\frac{72\,900}{100} \\ {3}^{t} & =729 \\ {3}^{t} & ={3}^{6} \\ t & =6\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the number of followers increases to $72\,900$ after $6$ weeks.
